ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Flooded Canyon
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
FLOOD_CANYON_BIOME_1 (owner ruling, 2026-09-12, verbatim on the filing event: the flood-witness work restructures into its own standalone biome mod — canyons that get periodically flooded, flooding as one of its events, the chime warning mechanic included). A dry canyon biome and its own hazard kit, fully generalized: it names no other franchise or campaign and is playable standalone on any generated RimWorld planet. It generalizes the mechanic sketched for a frozen campaign world's own canyon biome elsewhere in this repo (design/Jawa/worldbuilding/biomes/the_cracked_lands.md) with zero campaign-specific content — no named factions, no lore proper nouns, nothing that names the source campaign.
RM tier: nothing here knows what campaign or planet uses it.
Ships three mechanics, every one togglable in Mod Settings (defaults = shipped behavior, MOD_OPTIONS_RETROFIT_1 doctrine):
1. The Flooded Canyon biome: a rare, hot, high-relief canyon country that inserts into worldgen via a rarity slider (0 = never generates, same "1-3 rare patches by default" pattern as the sibling Gelatinous Slime mod's own worker). 2. The flood cycle: each canyon-biome map (or, opted in, ANY map) carries its own clock to the next flood. A chime warning rings ahead of the water (the source sheet's "water chimes ring... tones rolling up through the stone ahead of any sound of water", generalized to a reused vanilla notification cue — no new audio commissioned for v1). Then the wall arrives: a footprint of the canyon floor floods for a set duration, at light and non-fatal hazard to anyone caught standing in it, and drains to real fertile soil once it recedes — "death, then soil" as an engine, not a set piece. 3. Soak-driven growth: ground the flood just soaked carries a temporary plant-growth-rate multiplier that decays over a few days, so the newly wet floor visibly rushes to green before drying out — a light, toggleable coupling to the flood, not the full elaborate visual/burst mechanic drafted for EXPLOSIVE_PLANT_GROWTH_1 (a separate, larger, unbuilt item this mod does not attempt).
NOT in this mod (owned elsewhere, per the calling item's own boundary): the Utinni campaign's guaranteed first-witnessing quest beat (FLOOD_WITNESS_EVENT_1) and the full mesh-rebuild/burst plant-growth engine (EXPLOSIVE_PLANT_GROWTH_1) — both consume this mod as a dependency rather than living inside it.
